item.title: GVL Remains Committed to Supporting Education in its Concession Areas
item.description: Since 2019, GVL has supported more than 50 public schools in Sinoe and Grand Kru counties with monthly stipends for over 130 volunteer teachers. Volunteer teachers are appointed directly by schools, overseen by educational authorities. GVL does not recruit teaching staff.
